label: WorkBuddy
notes: Tencent CodeBuddy Code (genie). This desktop build ships only the headless bundle, so `/login` cannot run from it; the account session was established with the full npm distribution (@tencent-ai/codebuddy-code) launched against THIS install's product.json, and both binaries share the resulting stored session. CRITICAL: the CLI takes its whole product identity from ACC_PRODUCT_CONFIG_PATH (see run.env). The identical relative path inside the npm package holds a CodeBuddy config (www.codebuddy.ai), and the same binary then rejects a WorkBuddy account with 'Authentication required' — which is why discovery ignores PATH and accepts only this install's own entry. Output is a JSON ARRAY of events whose last element is the result. 2026-10-15 LAYOUT CHANGE: the app update replaced cli/dist/* with the lite bundle `dist/codebuddy-lite-wb.mjs`, and the old `bin/codebuddy` launcher now fails in print mode with "Cannot find module '../dist/codebuddy'" (its headless bundle is gone). Discovery therefore PREFERS the .mjs entry, which supports both --version and -p, and keeps bin/codebuddy only as a fallback for older installs. Credentials: the CLI accepts CODEBUDDY_AUTH_TOKEN / CODEBUDDY_API_KEY from the environment, but its own stored session is encrypted and this plugin never reads or writes it.

safety.note: Runs headless with -p. No permission-bypass flag is declared, so the CLI keeps its own prompts. The account token is read from the environment; this plugin never stores or writes one.
